output.source_text: The diminished scale is an octatonic (8-note) symmetrical scale created by repeating interval patterns. A diminished chord consists of stacked minor 3rds (C, Eb, Gb, A).

note_vi: Bài 28 của nguồn Jazz Scales (YouTube), mốc 00:06-01:05. The diminished scale is an octatonic (8-note) symmetrical scale created by repeating interval patterns.
